hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: We are given two coprime prime integers primeOne and primeTwo.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: According to the Frobenius coin problem / Chicken McNugget Theorem, for two coprime integers a and b, any amount greater than a * b - a - b can be formed as a non-negative linear combination.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: The largest integer that cannot be expressed in this form is precisely primeOne * primeTwo - primeOne - primeTwo.
